The remaining standing calendar, however, still directs its visible grid front toward the audience and its back toward the seated user.

actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

blockingFindings.description: Standing calendar's grid front still faces audience; its actual seated user is behind it.
blockingFindings.targetedCorrection: Change only this standing calendar to a flat text-free planning sheet on the desk or turn the calendar face toward its user. Preserve corrected cost distinction and all other good areas.

interpretationLimits: No inevitable bankruptcy or claim that every credit use is harmful is represented. The scale is conceptual, not a numerical affordability calculation.
